outcome.technical: scripts/diffmap.mjs: diffmap(model, changes, {outDir}) drops every changed file under outDir; new exported outputDirOf(repo, modelPath) gives the repo-relative directory holding the model (null when outside the repo or at its root); the CLI passes it, so committed or untracked map artifacts are no changed file, make no area affected and are never uncovered. Report shape unchanged. scripts/merge.mjs: new merge({changed}) and CLI --changed <diffmap.json> (its files array, or a plain JSON array; needs --areas; unreadable is exit 2). In update mode with changed, after fragments and evidence normalisation and before app nodes and reference resolution: each previous node/edge/entity owned by a replaced area whose evidence files (entity field evidence included) are all unchanged is set from --previous byte-identical (overriding or filling in the fragment's); a touched one the fragment left out is removed with a meta.sources row {area, type:'dropped-changed', id, note}, decided after extract generation so a regenerated entity gets no row. Carried nodes join their area's placed list after makeAppNodes (so area:<id> and the area's one-store rule see them); generateFromExtracts merges nothing into a carried entity and reuses a carried <area>-db store instead of making a -2 sibling. Derivation row gains derived.carried and a note clause; without extracts in carry mode a minimal derivation row is written (replacing the previous one). Without --changed the code path is unchanged. scripts/pipeline.mjs: plan --update writes the diffmap report to <work>/diffmap.json (added to BUILD_FILES); mergeArgs passes --changed <work>/diffmap.json in update mode for both finish and render, so render keeps the carried elements. skills/architecture-map/references/model-schema.md: update paragraph documents the output-directory exclusion, the carry-over rules, dropped-changed rows, derived.carried, and that without --changed an area is replaced wholesale. Tests: d13 (diffmap), m30, m30b, m30c, m30d (merge), p37 (pipeline). Own command `node --test tests/diffmap.test.mjs tests/merge.test.mjs tests/pipeline.test.mjs` exit 0, 113 tests, 113 pass.
